predecessor.migration_note: Current config9 preserves the substantive CLEAN multi-agent assignment and changes invocation lifecycle only; Part84's exact Part85 continuation was therefore resumed under the new frozen config9 tuple.

tested_scope: One bounded official-documentation authority-separation classification for zero-entitlement GitHub repository and organization rulesets, combined only with the current role-local Part84 recreation finding. No other worker, downstream, O, aggregate ledger, or legacy semantic input was read.

public_sources.observation: Repository rulesets are available for public repositories on GitHub Free and GitHub Free for organizations. People with repository admin access, or a custom role with edit-repository-rules permission, can create, edit, disable, and delete repository rulesets.

Rulesets that apply to multiple repositories in an organization are documented for GitHub Team and GitHub Enterprise customers; repository-level rulesets remain separately available for public Free repositories.

repository_owner_or_admin_policy_deletio.basis: Official docs explicitly grant repository admins or edit-repository-rules roles the ability to edit/disable/delete the repository ruleset. The same repository-level authority that can roll back protected refs can therefore also remove this policy witness unless authority is separated elsewhere.

repository_transfer_or_recreation_under_.basis: Part84 role-local evidence already covered repository delete/recreate/ref-name-reuse and found repository-local policy non-monotonic across recreation. This slice adds no stronger Free repository-level authority: the policy is still admin-mutable. A transfer to another repository administrative domain does not by itself create a historical monotonic witness unless a separately persisted authority is consulted.

absence_of_paid_organization_or_enterpri.basis: Official GitHub documentation describes organization rulesets spanning multiple repositories for Team/Enterprise customers. That stronger policy locus is therefore outside the zero-entitlement acceptance route tested here.

result.new_falsification: Free public-repository rulesets are useful enforcement while active but are not an authority-separated monotonic anti-rollback witness against repository administrators because those administrators can edit, disable, or delete them. The documented stronger multi-repository organization ruleset locus is Team/Enterprise-gated and therefore fails the zero-entitlement gate.
result.minimal_unresolved_child: A zero-entitlement Chat-accessible monotonic witness outside the target repository administrator's mutation domain that durably binds repository incarnation plus minimum policy/generation epoch across admin changes, transfer, delete/recreate and ref-name reuse; or an independently documented platform guarantee with equivalent non-rollback semantics.
result.scope_guard: This is a bounded GitHub ruleset authority-domain classification, not a universal impossibility claim for all public identity/witness surfaces.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.rejected_candidate_dependency: Organization multi-repository rulesets are documented for GitHub Team/Enterprise and therefore are not accepted at zero entitlement.

frontier: Test a zero-entitlement separate-witness-repository architecture keyed by target repository immutable identity/incarnation, with target-admin unable to mutate witness but Chat repository APIs able to read/write it; reject if it requires manual/protected authority, another finite quota, or same-principal rollback.

If separate-witness storage fails, test whether any account-scoped/public GitHub identity or append-only surface exposed to Chat provides non-reusable incarnation plus monotonic epoch semantics without paid entitlement.
Retain repository-local rulesets only as active enforcement, not as the final anti-rollback witness.
exact_continuation: Part86: execute exactly one bounded separate-witness authority-domain leaf using official public documentation plus own clean state only. Test whether a second zero-entitlement public repository (or equivalent Chat-accessible account-scoped GitHub surface) can durably store target_repository_id/incarnation + minimum_generation/policy_epoch so that target-repository admins cannot roll it back, while Chat can update it through lightweight repository APIs at zero incremental cost. Required negatives: same account/principal controls both repositories, witness repository delete/force-rewind, target repository transfer, target delete/recreate under the same logical name, connector authorization not covering the witness, and any manual/protected setup step. Accept only if the authority separation and durable CAS/idempotency path remain valid when optional monthly/trial/paid quotas are zero; otherwise persist the exact remaining authority gap.
